LanguageData.VGE_ShieldOverheated: Gravship shield generator has overheated due to lack of empty heatsinks. Consider building more heatsinks.
LanguageData.VGE_CommandAutoRebuild_EscapePod: If this is on, {BUILDING_definite} will automatically be replaced after it's used.
LanguageData.VGE_EscapePod_EvacuationDesc: Initiates a gravship-wide evacuation protocol. All colonists will immediately seek out and board the closest available escape pod. The evacuation process plays a ship-wide siren until all pods have launched. If there is not enough escape pods, some colonists may fail to evacuate.
LanguageData.VGE_EscapePod_EvacuationConfirmation:
Are you sure you want to issue an evacuation?

Every colonist who's able to do so will immediately stop doing what they are doing and attempt to find an escape pod to use. If they're unable to immediately find an escape pod, they'll keep trying to find one unless they're drafted or an evacuation is stopped.

If you decide to cancel the evacuation your colonists will attempt to return to anything they may have been working on at the time (if that's possible).
LanguageData.VGE_VacuumEmergencyLight_UnsafeVacuumLev: Select a vacuum level that will be considered unsafe. Once the vacuum reaches this level the light will turn on and any undrafted colonists (without vacuum protective gear) will attempt to seek safety.
LanguageData.VGE_VacuumEmergencyLight_EvacuatePawns: Evacuate area when unsafe vacuum level reached

LanguageData.VGE_Visibility400k: Others are becoming aware of your gravship. Consider laying low for a while, or construct a signal jammer.
LanguageData.VGE_Visibility600kDesc:
Your gravship, {0}, has caught attention of others. If you continue to generate visibility, you will encounter a gravship-level threat.

Visibility is generated as your gravship travels, but also when you use gravship weaponry or perform orbital scans from your gravship. It lowers passively over time.

Gravship-level threats can include orbital bombardment platforms, pirate installations or even enemy gravships. They will actively engage you with powerful artillery over huge distances. If your gravship is unprepared, it will be obliterated.

At this moment, your gravship is armed with:

{1}

LanguageData.VGE_GravshipGraveyardLetterText: You have detected the distinct energy signature of a gravcore emanating from a massive field of debris: a gravship graveyard. You know that when you arrive, your navigation systems will be locked. An ancient signal jammer is active within the debris field, preventing your gravship from initiating the launch. You must navigate through the field of unstable ancient gravmines, locate the source of the jamming, and neutralize it to escape.\n\nBe careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
